title: AI Assistant for Governance: Empowering Team-Based dReps

ms.promise:
We will create a roadmap detailing the tasks and actions for our AI agent. Some tasks and actions may include, but are not limited to: 
・Summarizing key points of proposals.
・Identifying potential impacts (economic, social, technical, and environmental if Photrek's experience is applicable).
・Highlighting relevant sections of the Cardano constitution.
・Analyzing the proposed organizational design of the project: Team size and composition, Decision-making process and Incentive structures.
・Providing data-driven insights and recommendations to guide informed decision-making.

We may also receive further suggestions from the community regarding other actions the AI agent could do. Guided by the community feedback, we may adjust our roadmap to add additional tasks and actions for the AI Agent, focused on the actions most demanded by the community.
ms.criteria: Roadmap created detailing all the tasks and actions that the AI Agent can assume is aligned with the proposed list (above) of capabilities. Anything missing from the above list must have clear justification as to why the actions is not fit for an AI agent role, additional tasks and actions are also permitted with justification of the need.

ms.promise:
We will use a framework designed to help developers build applications that combine large language models (LLMs) with other sources of computation or knowledge. ​​It allows efficient integration of different LLMs, which can help compare models and choose the best one for a specific use case. Additionally, the framework is designed to manage complex workflows and interactions between LLMs and external tools or databases, which is beneficial for implementing data collection, analysis, and feedback integration.
LLM that will be considered include:

• OpenAI’s GPT-4: Suitable for natural language understanding and generation tasks.
• Anthropic’s Claude: Known for safe and aligned language model outputs.
• Cohere’s Command R: Designed for retrieval-augmented generation tasks.
• Local Models (like LLaMA, Falcon, etc.): These can be deployed locally to have more control over data privacy and customization.

ms.criteria:
AI agent can successfully complete at least one task in a controlled environment.

• Accuracy: How accurately the AI performs tasks, such as summarizing or evaluating proposals (target above 85%).
• Response Time: Time it takes the AI agent to complete a task (e.g., less than 7 seconds per task).
• Error Rate: Percentage of outputs that require manual correction (should aim for <10%).
